name: smartfactory-os
description: SmartFactory OS — modular industrial operating platform

scripts.test: turbo run test && pnpm run test:validators
scripts.test:ci: turbo run test --concurrency=1 --force && pnpm run test:validators
scripts.test:validators: turbo run build --filter=./modules/* && node --test tools/manifest-validator/index.test.mjs tools/event-catalog/index.test.mjs tools/rls-checker/index.test.mjs
scripts.lint: turbo run lint && eslint tools/manifest-validator tools/event-catalog tools/rls-checker
scripts.validate: pnpm run validate:deps && pnpm run validate:manifests && pnpm run validate:events && pnpm run validate:rls && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck
